_about: Early warning by trend projection (team decision, 15 Nov 2026), instead of the ML 'time-to-event' models of the uploaded AI blueprint (their risk formulas and crisis thresholds have no source and no real astronaut outcome data exists to train on). Method: daily means of the last windowDays, Theil–Sen slope (median of all pairwise slopes; its 25th–75th percentile gives the range), projected to the limits already in thresholds.json. It says when a value would cross a documented limit if the trend goes on; it never raises an alarm and never names a disease or a probability. Numbers here are display settings (proposal), not medical limits.

kidney.title: Kidney stone risk rising
kidney.advice: Drink up to your daily water target. Pain in your side or blood in urine: press Emergency.
kidney.source: Periodic Health Tasks Checklist (water < 2.5 L/day raises kidney stone risk; urine specific gravity); bone loss document (urinary calcium R_Ca)

fatigue.title: Tiredness risk rising
fatigue.advice: Sleep longer and take a short nap. Ask the commander to move hard tasks. Do the reaction test.
fatigue.source: Periodic Health Tasks Checklist sections 3, 5 and 11; Mission readiness panel (Chart Blueprint)

energy.title: Eating too little
energy.advice: Eat your full meals and add a snack. Weigh yourself twice a week.
energy.source: Periodic Health Tasks Checklist section 4 and 8; nutrition document (NASA JSC 67378)

co2.title: Cabin CO₂ rising
co2.advice: Check the CO₂ scrubber and fans. Several people with headache: press Emergency, choose Cabin.
co2.source: Main Panel Alarm Checklist (cabin CO₂); NASA OCHMO TB-004

_aboutMetrics: Daily or weekly values only: weekly ones (body mass, urine) use 8 weeks. Continuous vitals (blood pressure, temperature) keep 24 h of data in this demo and are watched by the limits and the personal baseline instead.
